race.comment: COSMIC VOYAGE (7) looks very well placed on resumption having just missed on debut at Donald in May, in the market there and only beaten a nose. Better this time around and can go one better. STRENGTH WITHIN (12) raced once in the maiden preparation when tenth at Ballarat over 1000m back on May 24. It wouldn't shock if she did much better this time around for the Meech/Dabernig combination. MOAB (4) daughter of Royal Symphony from I'm Explosive on debut. Coming along well at the trials with a minor placing at her most recent. Keep an eye on the betting. HARD HITTER (1) returns from a lay-off. Ran fourth in a jump-out at Ararat. Opened last campaign with a fifth at Dunkeld over 1000m. Include in wider plays.
